y") != "all_unique_formally_proved_mapped_verilog_digests":
        raise TimingEvidenceError("unsupported timing-contract selection_policy")
    if raw.get("parasitics") is not None:
        raise TimingEvidenceError("this pre-layout evidence level requires parasitics to be null")
    _required_string(raw, "wire_model", "timing_contract")

    opensta = raw.get("opensta")
    if not isinstance(opensta, dict):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("timing_contract.opensta must be a JSON object")
    if _required_string(opensta, "repository", "timing_contract.opensta") != (
        "parallaxsw/OpenSTA"
    ):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("timing contract targets an unsupported OpenSTA repository")
    commit = _required_string(opensta, "commit", "timing_contract.opensta")
    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", commit) is None:
        raise TimingEvidenceError("timing_contract.opensta.commit must be a full Git SHA")
    return raw


def _load_tool_metadata(path: Path, binary: Path, contract: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    raw = _load_json(path)
    if not isinstance(raw, dict) or raw.get("schema") != "hephaestus.opensta-tool.v1":
        raise TimingEvidenceError("unsupported OpenSTA tool metadata schema")
    expected = contract["opensta"]
    if raw.get("repository") != expected["repository"]:
        raise TimingEvidenceError("OpenSTA tool repository differs from the timing contract")
    if raw.get("commit") != expected["commit"]:
        raise TimingEvidenceError("OpenSTA tool commit differs from the timing contract")
    digest = raw.get("binary_sha256")
    if not isinstance(digest, str) or _SHA256_RE.fullmatch(digest) is None:
        raise TimingEvidenceError("OpenSTA tool metadata has an invalid binary digest")
    if sha256_file(binary) != digest:
        raise TimingEvidenceError("OpenSTA binary digest differs from tool metadata")
    banner = raw.get("banner")
    if not isinstance(banner, str) or not banner.startswith("OpenSTA "):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("OpenSTA tool metadata has no valid version banner")
    cudd = raw.get("cudd")
    if not isinstance(cudd, dict):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("OpenSTA tool metadata has no CUDD provenance")
    cudd_digest = cudd.get("sha256")
    if not isinstance(cudd_digest, str) or _SHA256_RE.fullmatch(cudd_digest) is None:
        raise TimingEvidenceError("OpenSTA CUDD provenance has an invalid digest")
    return raw


def _require_claims(claims: Any, required: tuple[str, ...], *, context: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(claims, dict):
        raise TimingEvidenceError(f"{context} claims are malformed")
    missing = [name for name in required if claims.get(name) is not True]
    if missing:
        raise TimingEvidenceError(
            f"{context} is missing required true claims: {missing}"
        )
    return claims


def _validate_sources(
    area_path: Path,
    formal_path: Path,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    area = _load_json(area_path)
    formal = _load_json(formal_path)
    if not isinstance(area, dict) or area.get("schema") != (
        "hephaestus.abc-area-delay-evidence.v1"
    ):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("unsupported ABC area-delay evidence schema")
    if area.get("evidence_level") != "abc_liberty_area_delay_estimate":
        raise TimingEvidenceError("unsupported ABC area-delay evidence level")
    area_claims = _require_claims(
        area.get("claims"), _REQUIRED_AREA_CLAIMS, context="ABC area-delay evidence"
    )
    if area_claims.get("mapped_gate_level_equivalence_verified") is not False:
        raise TimingEvidenceError("source ABC evidence must not pre-claim formal equivalence")

    if not isinstance(formal, dict) or formal.get("schema") != (
        "hephaestus.abc-area-delay-formal-evidence.v1"
    ):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("unsupported ABC area-delay formal evidence schema")
    if formal.get("evidence_level") != "yosys_sat_abc_area_delay_mapped_equivalence":
        raise TimingEvidenceError("unsupported ABC area-delay formal evidence level")
    _require_claims(
        formal.get("claims"), _REQUIRED_FORMAL_CLAIMS, context="ABC formal evidence"
    )
    source = formal.get("source")
    if not isinstance(source, dict):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("ABC formal source metadata is malformed")
    if source.get("abc_area_delay_evidence_sha256") != sha256_file(area_path):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("ABC formal evidence does not bind the exact area-delay manifest")

    area_contract =
